faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Windsor?
faq.answer: Windsor homeowners typically invest $4,500 to $10,500 for a full window replacement project covering 10–16 windows. This growing Sonoma County town features 1990s–2010s homes in planned neighborhoods throughout the Town Green and Vintage Greens area. Standard sizing in planned developments makes replacement efficient. Single window installation starts at approximately $440.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Windsor?
faq.answer: Yes. Windsor requires a building permit for window replacements. HOA requirements may apply in certain planned communities. Our team manages all permit applications with the Town of Windsor Building Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Windsor?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Windsor commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Windsor?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Windsor replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Windsor?
faq.answer: Most Windsor projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
